title: Why piano gave him a harmonic foundation
summary: Learning piano taught him harmony along with melody, which made improvising easier; musicians of the day learned tunes with their harmony.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Piano was my first instrument, yes. I find that now, having studied piano it gave me a foundation -- a harmonic foundation a lot of musicians just didn't have, and it gave me -- I became conscious of harmony along with the melody. I find so many musicians today -- they learn a melody but they never learn the harmonic construction. In those days, any time you learned a tune you learned the harmony the same time you learned the melody. Therefore, you can analyze.
And it made improvisation much easier.
